$schema: clone-website extraction artifact — consumed by scripts/emit-design-system.ts
name: Marcos Arruda Portfolio

extraction.method: Playwright inspection of the published Wix site at 1440px, 768px, and 390px; computed styles, route crawl, and image/video inventory.
extraction.note: The site switches between black long-form case-study surfaces and white gallery surfaces. OpenDesign's primary foreground is the white-gallery ink; dark sections deliberately use --surface as their foreground.

--bg.reason: Default canvas on the home page, long-form case studies, footer, and menu overlay.

--surface.reason: White section surface, header bar, case-study reading bands, and gallery canvas.

--surface-warm.reason: Quiet off-white gallery and media fallback surface between observed pure white panels.

--fg.reason: Primary ink on white header, case-study reading bands, and gallery headings.

--fg-2.reason: Observed neutral third color used in the Wix palette and low-emphasis labels.

--muted.reason: Case-card descriptions and secondary footer copy on black.

--meta.reason: Observed Wix neutral palette tier and subtle gallery metadata.

--border.reason: Thin white-panel dividers and gallery gutters.

--border-soft.reason: Softer separator for dense white galleries.

--accent.reason: Signature acid-yellow highlight across bio copy, role wordmark, and navigation.

--accent-on.reason: Black text/icon ink on the luminous acid-yellow accent.

--accent-hover.reason: Observed muted yellow on View Project actions.

--accent-active.reason: Conservative pressed state derived from the observed action yellow.

--success.reason: OpenDesign semantic fallback; no success state appears in the target.

--warn.reason: OpenDesign semantic fallback; no warning state appears in the target.

--danger.reason: OpenDesign semantic fallback; no error state appears in the target.

--font-display.reason: Local mirror of the observed Wix Space Grotesk display files.

--font-body.reason: Observed Avenir Light body family, with local mirror from the target request.

--font-mono.value: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
--font-mono.reason: OpenDesign fallback; the site has no monospace content.

--text-2xl.reason: Desktop home name and large supporting headings.

--text-4xl.reason: Bridge display tier for case-study title screens; observed desktop title is visually between 48px and 64px.

--leading-body.reason: 20px case-card text is observed at 32px line height.

--leading-tight.reason: Observed heading rhythm throughout the home and case pages.

--tracking-display.reason: Space Grotesk display headings use normal letter spacing.

--space-1.reason: Smallest practical spacing tier for highlighted spans and UI details.

--space-2.reason: Base small gap used by compact header identity.

--space-4.reason: Shared baseline spacing in gallery cards.

--space-8.reason: Observed case-card paragraph leading and section subgaps.

--space-12.reason: Observed collaboration heading size and useful macro rhythm tier.

--section-y-desktop.reason: The white case-study introduction band and major home sections use roughly this vertical rhythm.

--section-y-tablet.reason: Intermediate responsive rhythm between desktop and mobile captures.

--section-y-phone.reason: Mobile section rhythm around gallery and footer content.

--radius-sm.reason: The site uses square media panels and text links rather than rounded UI.

--radius-md.reason: Case-study and gallery panels remain square.

--radius-lg.reason: No rounded featured containers are observed.

--radius-pill.reason: Schema utility token; no pill control is visible on the target.

--elev-flat.reason: Wix layout uses flat media and flat color bands.

--elev-ring.reason: Thin separator fallback for gallery media.

--elev-raised.reason: No card shadow or floating elevation is evident.

--focus-ring.reason: Accessible enhancement anchored to the verified accent.

--motion-fast.reason: The target does not expose a named CSS duration; concise menu/link transition used for progressive enhancement.

--motion-base.reason: Footer link transitions are observed at 0.3s ease-in-out.

--container-max.reason: Desktop footer content is 1296px wide at a 1440px viewport.

--container-gutter-desktop.reason: At 1440px the site uses a 72px gutter, exactly 5vw.

--container-gutter-tablet.reason: Preserves the measured desktop proportional gutter at 768px.

--container-gutter-phone.reason: The mobile home capture places primary text about 12px from the viewport edge.
